name: crop_condition_mnv3s
training_data: PlantVillage (CC0) maize + tomato; rice from minhhungg/rice-disease-dataset (Apache-2.0); papaya from Project-AgML/papaya_leaf_disease_classification_bangladesh (CC BY 4.0, raw config); plus an 'other' class generated from the app's own imagery
status: development — trained on public datasets photographed outside Timor-Leste (PlantVillage studio images, rice from South-East Asia, papaya from Bangladesh). Not field-validated in Timor-Leste. Every output is a possible finding, never a confirmed diagnosis.
notes: Sources differ per crop, so cross-dataset generalisation to real field photos is unverified. The margin guard (confidence >= 0.55 AND top1 - top2 >= 0.20) exists because of this: a near-tie is reported as unclear rather than guessed. Weakest classes are maize_leaf_spot (77.8%) and tomato_leaf_problem (79.7%), both merged multi-disease classes.
